name: Kuppannagari Mahendra Aravind
title: Full-Stack Developer · Applied AI Systems
tagline: I build reliable backend systems and grounded AI products, and ship them to production.
about: I build the part of software that has to keep working when nobody is watching: the servers, databases and queues underneath, and the AI features that sit on top of them. Mostly Java and Spring Boot, some Python and FastAPI, with React or Next.js on the front.

PulseOps watches servers and raises one clear alert when something breaks. To test it, I switched off one of its two servers in the middle of live traffic; every request still got an answer. Project Atlas answers questions about huge project documents, and refuses to answer when it cannot point to the page it got the answer from. It reached the finals of the Economic Times AI Hackathon 2.0.
Both run live on AWS, deployed by CI/CD pipelines and covered by automated tests. I am in my final year at LNMIIT Jaipur and looking for SDE roles in backend, full-stack or applied AI.
lookingFor: Software Development Engineer roles in backend, full-stack and applied AI.
